content:
ops-bot: PAGER ALERT: P1 - intermittent 503s from tokenization-service in us-west-2 impacting /v1/embeddings and /v1/similarity endpoints. Error spike started ~ 2026-03-17T18:02Z. Runbook: <https://intra.redwood/runbooks/tokenization-503>.

alex: ack. I’m oncall for US-WEST. Triage starting — pinging infra and runtime.

jemma: I’m here. Initial check: genqueue depth doubled, a subset of workers returning 503 from tokenization stage. Caused by KV cache churn + sudden prefix miss rate.

alex: doing a tail of tokenization logs now — running:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/tokenizer-usw -c tokenizer --since=15m | rg "503|error" -n
kubectl -n genqueue top pods
```

jemma: logs show `IOException: remote kv read timeout` + retry loops. Suspect storage latency (S3 proxy) causing tokenization stage to fail under burst.

rita: ops-liaison here — drafting initial statuspage copy, pushing a short customer note. Draft below, please comment: 

```
{
  "impact": "Intermittent errors for embeddings and similarity requests in US-WEST",
  "status": "investigating",
  "details": "We are investigating intermittent 503 errors affecting embeddings and similarity endpoints for a subset of requests routed to US-WEST. Engineers are investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal traffic. Services in other regions are unaffected. We will post updates every 30 minutes or as new information becomes available.",
  "customer_impacted": "Some requests may return 503 or see increased latency. No data loss reported.",
  "workaround": "If possible, retry requests or route to a different region.",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T18:12:00Z"
}
```

alex: couple edits: change "retry requests" to "exponential backoff + jitter" and add link to regional fallback docs. Also remove JSON wrapper (statuspage expects markdown).

rita: updated draft to markdown below — ready for quick legal check before publish:

```
We are investigating intermittent 503 errors affecting embeddings and similarity requests routed to US-WEST. Engineers are actively investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal service. Services in other regions are not affected.

Impact: Some requests may return 503 or experience increased latency. No data loss has been observed.

Workaround: If possible, retry with exponential backoff and jitter or route requests to a different region (see https://docs.redwood.ai/regional-fallback).

We will provide updates every 30 minutes or as new information becomes available.

Reported: 2026-03-17T18:12:00Z (UTC)
```

legal-review-bot: quick note from legal: remove phrase "No data loss has been observed" — try "We have not identified any evidence of data loss at this time." Also avoid promising recovery windows.

rita: thanks, adjusted wording. New draft below — publish-ready?

alex: good for publish. I’ll attach initial internal mitigations note: we scaled tokenizer worker pool + temporarily routed 30% of US-WEST traffic to the smaller quantized model as a fallback. Observing error rate drop but still validating stability.

statusbot: STATUSPAGE PUBLISH: Initial update published to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/tokenization-503-usw at 2026-03-17T18:22:46Z by alex.

ops-bot: MITIGATION NOTE: applied autoscale policy increase + 30% traffic split to quantized-fallback-v2. Rolling restarts of tokenizer pods to clear KV cache.

jemma: monitoring: error rate fell from 7.8% -> 1.6% within 8 minutes of mitigations. Queue depth trending down. Still seeing occasional retries.

alex: plan: continue mitigation for next 30m, confirm no customer-facing regressions, then start gradual rollback of split if stable. Will prepare next public update at +30m.

rita: preparing 30m update draft now.

--- 30 minutes later ---

ops-bot: INTERIM UPDATE: error rate stable ~0.8%. Some residual latency for long sequences.

rita: 30m statuspage draft: 

```
Update: Mitigations in place (worker autoscale + fallback routing). Error rate and queue depth have significantly improved. We continue to monitor. If your applications require lower latency, consider temporary routing to another region.

We will post another update in 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.
```

alex: +1. Also add note: "We will follow up with a resolved notice once traffic is fully restored and no elevated errors observed for 60 minutes."

legal-review-bot: wording OK.

statusbot: UPDATE PUBLISHED at 2026-03-17T18:52:10Z by rita.

--- 70 minutes after initial alert ---

jemma: monitoring shows errors down to baseline 0.1% for 40+ minutes; queue fully drained, KV latency normalized. Rolling rollback started for fallback split.

alex: initiating resolved copy draft:

```
Resolved: As of 2026-03-17T19:18:00Z (UTC) we have restored normal service for embeddings and similarity requests in US-WEST. The incident was caused by increased KV read latency leading to tokenization stage failures. Mitigations included autoscaling tokenizer workers, rolling restarts to recover KV cache, and a temporary routing of a portion of traffic to a quantized fallback model.

Impact: A subset of embeddings and similarity requests in US-WEST experienced intermittent 503 errors and elevated latency between ~18:02 UTC and ~19:18 UTC. We have not identified any evidence of data loss.

Follow-up: We will run a post-incident review to determine preventive steps (improve KV read resiliency, circuit-breakers at tokenization, better autoscale thresholds).
```

rita: LGTM. publishing resolved now.

statusbot: RESOLVED PUBLISH: Resolved notice posted to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/tokenization-503-usw at 2026-03-17T19:19:58Z by rita.

alex: closing oncall handoff. Will file follow-up postmortem and link to statuspage incident. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

jemma: good job, quick response. Filing postmortem ticket: INT-2026-315.

statusbot: NOTE: internal oncall timeline and mitigation steps archived to /incidents/INT-2026-315.
